plan: My value is $39. To maximize profit, I should aim to bid lower than my value but high enough to outbid competitors. A bid slightly below my value, like $38.9, may maximize profit if others bid lower. This ensures a positive payoff even in the worst-case scenario of paying the second-highest bid close to mine. This balance between winning and minimizing costs should maximize long-term profit.
